newsitem.title: USA: Cronos engages counsel for SEC probe.
newsitem.headline: Cronos engages counsel for SEC probe.

text.p: The Cronos Group said it has engaged a special securities counsel in the United States to represent the company in an investigation by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said late on Thursday that it is cooperating with the investigation, but provided no other details.
It also said it has not found new auditors to replace Arthur Anderson, which resigned as its auditors on February 3.

Cronos Group Vice President Stephen Brocato said later that the company hired a counsel to deal with an SEC probe into charges made by Arthur Anderson. He said the Cronos Global Income Fund 16, a limited partnership in California, disclosed the charges in a filing with the SEC.

"We are unable to really speak with a lot of freedom about what's going on," Brocato said. "There are lot of rumors floating around. There are rumors about the president of leasing division resigning, but none of those are true. It's business as usual here."
